XMLProcessor.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a new instance by storing the provided file name and setting the root attribute to None." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> file_name </REF>: string "The file name to be stored in the instance attribute self.file_name."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the value of the input file_name to the instance attribute self.file_name. RESULT self.file_name]
            [COMMAND Set the instance attribute self.root to None. RESULT self.root]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
XMLProcessor.read_xml:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Parses the XML file specified by self.file_name, stores the root element in self.root, and returns it, or returns None if parsing fails." read_xml]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The object instance whose file_name attribute contains the path to the XML file."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: Element or None "The parsed XML root element, or None if an exception occurs."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Parse the XML file located at self.file_name using ET.parse. RESULT tree]
            [COMMAND Retrieve the root element from the parsed tree using tree.getroot(). RESULT root]
            [COMMAND Set self.root to the retrieved root element. RESULT self.root]
            [COMMAND Return self.root. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If ET.parse(self.file_name) or tree.getroot() raises any exception, control moves to the except block.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return None to indicate that the XML could not be parsed or read. RESULT None]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
XMLProcessor.write_xml:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Writes the XML tree rooted at self.root to the specified file and returns True on success, or False if an exception occurs." write_xml]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> file_name </REF>: str "The path of the file to which the XML tree should be written."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: bool "True if the XML file was written successfully; False if an exception occurred."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Build an ElementTree object from self.root and assign it to tree. RESULT tree]
            [COMMAND Write the XML tree to the file specified by file_name. RESULT None]
            [COMMAND Return True after a successful write. RESULT True]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: An exception occurs during ElementTree construction or file writing.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Catch the exception and return False. RESULT False]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
XMLProcessor.process_xml_data:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Uppercases the text content of every descendant <item> element in the XML tree, then returns the result of writing the modified XML to the specified file." process_xml_data]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> file_name </REF>: str "Name or path of the XML file to write after the transformation."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: object "Result returned by self.write_xml(file_name)."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate through every descendant element named 'item' produced by self.root.iter('item') in document order. RESULT element]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over item elements, store the current text content of element as text. RESULT text]
            [COMMAND Within the loop over item elements, set element.text to the uppercase version of text by calling text.upper(). RESULT element.text]
            [COMMAND After the loop completes, call self.write_xml(file_name) with the modified XML tree and return its result. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
XMLProcessor.find_element:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Finds all child elements under self.root matching the given element_name and returns them as a list." find_element]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> element_name </REF>: string "The tag name or XPath-like pattern used to select matching child elements."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> elements </REF>: list "List of matching child elements; empty if no matches were found."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Call findall on self.root with element_name to retrieve all matching child elements, and assign the resulting list to elements. RESULT elements]
            [COMMAND Return the elements list. RESULT elements]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
